imageurl.title: Home Screen
imageurl.description: Main menu of the game where players can start a new game, access settings, and view the scoreboard.

imageurl.title: Game Screen
imageurl.description: Core gameplay screen where players use gyroscope and motion sensors to survive horror events while interacting with the game environment.

imageurl.title: Game Over Screen
imageurl.description: Displayed when the player loses the game, showing the final result with options to restart or return to the home screen.

imageurl.title: Settings Screen
imageurl.description: Allows players to configure audio, gameplay preferences, and other game settings for a personalized experience.

imageurl.title: Scoreboard
imageurl.description: Displays player scores, high scores, and performance statistics to track progress and achievements.

description: Developed a horror mobile game using React Native, FastAPI, and MySQL. The game leverages gyroscope and motion sensors to create immersive gameplay interactions, triggering in-game horror events based on player movement. Designed suspense-driven mechanics with responsive environmental effects and dynamic sound systems.
